column_description: Unique identifier for each maintenance record.
ID of the robot. may be NULL.
Date the maintenance was performed. may be NULL.
Type of maintenance (e.g., routine, emergency). always exactly one of 'routine', 'emergency'. may be NULL.
Description of the maintenance performed. may be NULL.
User who performed the maintenance. may be NULL.
Date the next maintenance is due. may be NULL.
Duration of the maintenance in minutes. may be NULL.
